proposed_facts.reason: Canonical initialization excludes the trailing six x204 animation records, clears auxiliary ownership records without destruction, and selects the stated manager and numeric-display branches. The numeric constructor installs polling only for a nonzero argument; the Multi-Man helper does not install it. Independently inspected types and Multi-Man callers support persistent animation state and external numeric updates. The correction agrees with functionality.md and preserves the existing Init name without implying safe repeated reconstruction.

Canonical construction writes persistent user data before checking the replacement allocation, retains the previous stored pointer on JObj-load failure, and initializes all seven counters in mode 0 only at stocks <=5. The stock updater consumes surviving transfer counters and paths; modes 1 and 2 dispatch elsewhere. Counter values, hidden transfer icons, prioritized RGB tinting and immediate dispatch match the proposal. This is a factual correction rather than equivalent rewording.

contradictions.reason: Accept the supersession of the complete inactive-reset explanation: initialization explicitly excludes x204 and overwrites ownership state without first reclaiming existing objects.

Accept all five .data fact deferrals and both .data link deferrals. Constructor configuration and rules-selected presentation modes are supported, but a source switch does not establish a code-address table, section ownership, immutability, 24-byte extent or padding. The authored scene-name array also prevents treating the switch as sufficient layout evidence.

Accept all four .sdata fact deferrals and the .sdata link deferral. Retain supported muted-color selection and RGB-only application; source aggregates do not establish .sdata membership, a 16-byte extent or residual padding.
Accept all three .sdata2 fact deferrals. Geometry, interpolation and animation operands are visible, but their emitted literal-pool composition and section placement require compiled evidence.

Retain the lifecycle caveat and accept broader-reclamation deferral. Local main-grid cleanup visits only sixteen entries; the common HUD cleanup sequence does not justify claiming complete scene reclamation. Engine destruction can return after scheduling deferred removal.

Accept the mapper deferral. Canonical code contains an uninitialized-base path and a wrapper without an explicit return. Rendered character-frame names cannot establish compiled return behavior; neither proposed correction depends on resolving it.
